title: Evaluating and improving crop-yield forecasting methods during extreme drought
abstract: arXiv:2608.17971v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The impact of climate variability on food production has led to the creation of various forecasting models that uses machine learning (ML), numerical weather predictors (NWP) or a hybrid of ML-NWP models to identify structural and physical relationships between meteorological drivers and crop growth, in order to predict crop yield. Droughts, for example the 2012 Midwestern US (Corn Belt) drought, are extreme events that affect crop production and test the limits of these forecasting models. Using 16 meteorological drivers as predictors, we compare ML (non-deep learning) and deep learning forecasting models to predict the county-level corn yield for the extreme drought year, 2012. This forecasting problem is characterized by a dissimilarity between the feature distributions of the training and test data, where the meteorological conditions of the extreme drought year fall outside the range of historically observed values. translated_title: 极端干旱期间作物产量预测方法的评估与改进
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.17971v1 公告类型：新 摘要：气候变率对粮食生产的影响促使各种预测模型的创建，这些模型使用机器学习（ML）、数值天气预报（NWP）或ML-NWP混合模型来识别气象驱动因素与作物生长之间的结构和物理关系，以预测作物产量。干旱，例如2012年美国中西部（玉米带）干旱，是影响作物生产并考验这些预测模型极限的极端事件。使用16个气象驱动因素作为预测因子，我们比较了机器学习（非深度学习）和深度学习预测模型，以预测极端干旱年2012年的县级玉米产量。该预测问题的特点是训练和测试数据特征分布之间存在差异，其中极端干旱年的气象条件超出了历史观测值的范围。此外，本文还提出了一种改进方法，以增强模型在极端条件下的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文评估了多种机器学习与深度学习模型在极端干旱年份（如2012年美国玉米带干旱）下的作物产量预测性能，并针对训练与测试数据分布不一致的问题提出了改进策略，以提升模型在极端气候条件下的预测鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates machine learning and deep learning models for crop-yield forecasting under extreme drought conditions (e.g., the 2012 US Corn Belt drought) and proposes improvements to enhance model robustness when training and test data distributions diverge.
